name: Customer Proposal
description: Turn a job enquiry into a polished proposal or quote a customer will say yes to: what you understand they need, what you will deliver, when, for how much, and on what terms. The mission carries the enquiry and the pricing; the methodology gives it a professional shape.
principles: Lead with the customer's problem, not your business.
Be specific: real scope, real dates, real prices.
Make the price easy to understand and the next step easy to take.
Never promise what you cannot deliver.

stages.name: Prepare the proposal
stages.description: Understand the job and write a proposal the customer can accept.

quality_gate.description: The proposal states what will be delivered, a clear price, and a single next step.

activities.name: Write the proposal
activities.description: From the enquiry, write a persuasive, specific proposal: what you understand the customer needs, the scope and deliverables, a realistic timeline, a clear price, plain terms, and one easy next step. Where a price or detail was not provided, leave a clearly marked blank for the owner rather than inventing it.
